items.headline: No. 19 USC moves to 6-1, tops Penn State in White Out game
items.description: No. 19 Southern Cal outlasted Penn State 31- 23 on Saturday night at Beaver Stadium, a victory Trojans coach Lincoln Riley called one of this "favorites" after his team improved to 6-1 on the season.

items.headline: Best of Week 6: A Red River game winner and upsets galore in the SEC
items.description: With three top-10 ranked teams in the SEC losing, Week 6 had all the theatrics starting with Oklahoma's win.

items.headline: Jayden Maiava leads No. 19 USC past Penn State 31-23
items.description: — Jayden Maiava completed 21 of 33 passes for 301 yards with three touchdowns and No. 19 USC outlasted Penn State 31- 23 on Saturday night.
